title: Bishop Vs Queen
reviewNotes: Complete seven-piece diagram after ...Kxe4 at 96 seconds re-reviewed. h7 is the only winning root move; every king move loses. Source h7/a2/h8=Q and independent a1=Q/Qxa1 explain diagonal control, while Kxe6/a2 loses the essential tempo. Earlier eight-piece Be4 choice, uniqueness and other larger branches remain outside this exact proof.
